description: Walking a stair flight (world/flight.rs, the body is steered along the flight's own walk path by headless/steer.rs, since a straight walk no longer follows a switchback or spiral): walking down the nearest flight reaches the storey below on the frame the body crosses the midpoint, with no fade, no hold and no lockout. Walking up from there returns to the storey above. The level changes only through the shared hysteresis (level_from_height). Standing still on the landing does not change the level.
ported_from: game/player/player_controller_3d.gd floor snap and stairs; world/vertical.rs stair_surface_y, level_from_height

tests.name: standing on the landing of a flight down keeps the storey
walking forward down a flight reaches level -1 at depth 2
the storey changes on the frame the walk crosses the midpoint, and the walk goes on
an admin level jump rebuilds, a walk does not
walking forward up from level -1 returns to level 0
